# Test: for each color, check if all points lie on two intersecting lines (e.g. a V or L). Compute intersection of each pair's line with remaining points.
def line(p,q): return ((p[0]*q[1]-p[1]*q[0])/(p[0]-q[0]),(p[0]+q[0])/2,(p[1]+q[1])/2) if p[0]!=q[0] else None  # slope,b,center
for c,p in sorted(pos.items()):
    res=[]
    for i,a in enumerate(p):
        for j,b in enumerate(p):
            if i==j: continue
            if a[0]==b[0]: m=None; b_=a[1]
            elif a[1]==b[1]: m=(a[1]-b[1])/(a[0]-b[0]); b_=m*a[0]+b[1]
            else: continue
            on=[x for x in p if m is None and x[1]==b_]
            off=[x for x in p if not any((x[0],x[1])==(a[0],a[1]) or (x[0],x[1])==(b[0],b[1])) and (m*x[0]+b_-x[1])==0]
            res.append((len(on),off))
    print(c,res)

steps.input:
for d in (1,2,3,4,5):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {d} input'],G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(gi,bg)
    oo={}
    for cp in comps(go,bg):
        cs=tuple(sorted(set(go[a][b] for a,b in cp)))
        oo.setdefault(cs,len(cp))
    print('--- demo',d,'bg',bg)
    for cp in sorted(ci,key=lambda c:min(p[0]+p[1] for p in c)):
        cols=tuple(sorted(set(gi[a][b] for a,b in cp)))
        tag='*' if cols in (tuple([9,9]), tuple([4,4])) else ''
        print('  in comp n=%d colors=%s cells=%s'%(len(cp),cols,cp))
    print('  out comps:',{k:v for k,v in oo.items()})
